1.en_consolidated_definition:
Toil 

To labor or work.

To engage in physical or mental effort to achieve a goal or complete a task.

To exert oneself physically or mentally for the purpose of earning a living or accomplishing something.

To be employed or occupied in an activity or occupation.

To perform tasks or duties, especially those that are routine or repetitive.
